entries.title: Thief: The Dark Project

emulation.notes: Use Thief Gold with modern PC compatibility fixes.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Classic PC presentation with NewDark/TFix compatibility improvements.

primary.why: Thief Gold on Windows PC is the current best route because it includes The Dark Project plus the 1999 Gold update's three extra campaign missions and remains the practical PC route for modern compatibility fixes. The announced Nightdive remaster is not yet released, so it is only a future revisit.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Thief Gold on GOG or Steam, then use TFix guidance for modern resolution, NewDark, and compatibility before capture.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for a new playthrough by Thief Gold's added campaign missions.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded PC release with three added campaign missions and modern fix support.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete currently released route for the first Thief game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Thief Gold is the complete first-game route until the announced remaster ships and can be evaluated.

entries.remaster_caveats: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered has been announced for winter 2026 but is not released yet as of June 22, 2026, so it is not the current primary.

entries.definitive_edition: Thief II: The Metal Age on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use T2Fix/NewDark guidance for modern systems.

primary.how_to_play: Buy Thief II: The Metal Age on GOG or Steam and follow T2Fix guidance before streaming.

all_releases.fidelity: Classic PC release with modern NewDark/T2Fix compatibility options.
all_releases.reason: primary: only shipped platform and best modern route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Single-platform PC release; no alternate content route is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster is currently released.

entries.title: Thief: Deadly Shadows
entries.definitive_edition: Thief: Deadly Shadows on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with compatibility guidance.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with community quality-of-life options.

primary.version: GOG/Steam release with Sneaky Upgrade guidance
primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it has the complete game, PC capture/settings flexibility, and community compatibility/quality-of-life options. The Xbox release has no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Thief: Deadly Shadows on GOG or Steam and check for Sneaky Upgrade and modern compatibility notes before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with modern compatibility and Sneaky Upgrade options.
all_releases.reason: primary: best capture/fidelity route for the complete game.
skip: no sourced exclusive content and less capture/settings flexibility than Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content route is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster is currently released; use PC compatibility upgrades.

entries.title: Thief

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route for the 2014 reboot because it has the same game content with PC capture/settings flexibility. It is a reboot/fourth installment and should not be conflated with the Looking Glass/Ion Storm trilogy.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Thief on Steam or GOG and play the Windows PC build; check for any display, FOV, or performance notes.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 3 PC release with PC capture/settings flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: best capture/fidelity route for the reboot.

all_releases.fidelity: Console releases across seventh and eighth generation hardware.
all_releases.reason: skip: same reboot content family, with no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.
skip: no content advantage over Windows PC.
skip: access route, not a content or fidelity advantage over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content route is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the 2014 reboot/fourth installment, not the 1998 classic or its announced remaster.

entries.title: Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow
entries.definitive_edition: Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow on SteamVR

emulation.notes: Requires VR hardware; no flat-screen version is documented.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC VR presentation with SteamVR headset support.

primary.why: The SteamVR/Windows PC route is the best version because it is the full VR installment with PC VR capture potential and headset flexibility. Quest and PSVR2 are valid VR routes, but neither adds sourced exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow on Steam and play through a supported PC VR headset; use Quest or PSVR2 only if that is your available VR hardware.

all_releases.fidelity: PC VR release with SteamVR headset support and capture flexibility.

all_releases.reason: skip: valid VR route, but no sourced exclusive content over SteamVR.
skip: most convenient standalone route, but lower capture/fidelity priority than PC VR and no sourced exclusive content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content route is needed; choose SteamVR for the best capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a VR-only series entry, not a remaster of the classic Thief games.
